title: Species classifiers for microcontrollers
subtitle: int8 MobileNetV2 species classifiers for TFLite Micro and the Coral Edge TPU, companions to Google's AIY models
description:
# Model Summary

Species classifiers small enough for microcontrollers and the Coral Edge TPU, companions to Google's AIY Vision Kit iNaturalist models (google/aiy on Kaggle). MobileNetV2, full-integer int8, one deployment contract. Seven variations: mammals (246 species), arachnids (153), herps (483 reptiles and amphibians) and fungi (341), all 1.0 at 160 px, and three hive guards that tell honeybees from the hornets and yellowjackets that hunt them (265 species rolling up to 12 hive roles): hive (1.0/160, every tier), hive-coral (1.4/224, Edge TPU) and hive-esp32s3 (1.0/128, ESP32-S3). The fungi model is not for edibility decisions. Source, scripts and the GitHub release with checksums: https://github.com/mlgraham/species-classifiers

# Model Characteristics

Stock tf.keras MobileNetV2, no custom ops. Each variation ships int8 (uint8 in/out), the same model compiled with Edge TPU compiler 16.0 (every op mapped), float32, labels.txt and classes.json. The hive variations add roles.json, the hive role of every class. Ethos-U55 builds for the Seeed Grove Vision AI V2 are in the GitHub release.

# Data Overview

Trained on the iNaturalist 2021 competition dataset's train split (mammals 68,917 images, arachnids 40,687, herps 133,082, fungi 90,048), validated on its val split (10 images per species). The hive models add CC-licensed research-grade iNaturalist open-data photos (215,799 training images) and validate on 2,650 images.

# Evaluation Results

int8 file, 87.5% center crop: mammals 54.9% top-1 / 80.5% top-5 (grayscale 44.9% / 73.2%); arachnids 62.3% / 86.4%; herps 54.3% / 80.5% (grayscale 42.0% / 69.5%), below the 55% bar set for it before training, so treat it as a first cut; fungi 74.0% / 93.5%; hive 71.4% / 90.4% (89.2% of hornets and yellowjackets caught), hive-coral 80.9% / 94.3% (95.6%), hive-esp32s3 66.8% / 88.3% (88.3%). Google's stock AIY insect model scores 59.1% top-1 on the iNat2021 species it shares, choosing among 1,022 classes.
